Matrix Geo Solutions Wins Three-Year Adani Infra Contract for Precision Drone Surveying and Geospatial Solutions

2026-09-14 IT Voice Matrix Geo Solutions, Adani Infra, drone surveying, GIS, LiDAR, geospatial, mapping, infrastructure, India, precision surveying
Read the source article

Quick summary

Matrix Geo Solutions, an NSE-listed geospatial technology company, has secured a three-year Annual Rate Contract from Adani Infra for precision drone surveying, LiDAR, GIS, and mapping services across pan-India project locations.

Key takeaways

  • Matrix Geo Solutions won a three-year Annual Rate Contract (ARC) from Adani Infra
  • The contract covers geospatial, LiDAR, surveying, mapping, and allied technology-enabled services
  • Services include GIS, digital terrain and surface modelling, infrastructure mapping, and asset intelligence
  • The engagement spans pan-India project locations
  • Matrix Geo Solutions is an NSE-listed geospatial technology and engineering consultancy
  • The company previously completed a 314 km geospatial survey across five highway sections for RITES-NHAI
  • The contract highlights the growing role of drone-based surveying in Indian infrastructure
